editorial:
If you want a loud, bloody action movie with a no-nonsense hero, this one delivers. Frank Castle is back on the streets, hunting mob boss Billy Russoti after a botched hit leaves him scarred and reborn as Jigsaw. The story moves fast, throwing you into gunfights, chases, and brutal showdowns while the FBI and a special task force try to stop both sides. It feels like a comic book come to life, with big villains, dark humor, and a hero who never smiles. You do not need deep knowledge of the character to follow along, because the movie keeps the goal simple: stop Jigsaw before his army causes more damage.

The action is the main draw, with heavy shootouts and practical stunt work that keeps things moving. Ray Stevenson brings a tough, quiet presence to Frank, while Dominic West goes big as Jigsaw. Some scenes are over the top and the violence can be a lot, so it is not for everyone. Still, if you enjoy gritty vigilante stories, it is a fun ride. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, renting on Apple TV, or on 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final act, Jigsaw gathers a small army and attacks a building where Frank and his allies are hiding. Frank fights through the gang, kills Jigsaw's brother Loony Bin Jim, and finally confronts Jigsaw. After a brutal fight, Frank kills Jigsaw and escapes before the police arrive. The movie ends with Frank still on the run, ready to keep punishing criminals, while the task force realizes they cannot easily catch him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty vigilante action and comic book violence.
